WITH connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND f.module = 'auto_ontology.connectors.base'
    AND f.is_test = FALSE
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'function'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
    AND s.symbol_id IN (
      SELECT c.class_symbol_id || '::' || s.name
      FROM connector_classes c
      JOIN code.symbols s ON s.qualname LIKE c.class_symbol_id || '.%' AND s.file_id = c.class_symbol_id
    )
),
connector_class_body AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.class_symbol_id, m.method_name
  FROM connector_classes c
  JOIN connector_methods m ON m.symbol_id = c.class_symbol_id || '::' || m.method_name
),
sql_db_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.name = 'SQLDatabase'
),
sql_db_subclasses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s2.symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN code.symbols s2 ON cb.base_symbol_id = s2.symbol_id
  WHERE cb.class_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM sql_db_methods)
),
methods_defined_in_connector AS (
  SELECT cc.class_symbol_id, m.method_name
  FROM connector_class_body cc
  LEFT JOIN code.symbols m2
    ON m2.symbol_id = cc.class_symbol_id || '::' || cc.method_name
  WHERE m2.symbol_id IS NULL
),
methods_from_sql_db AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.class_symbol_id || '::' || m.method_name AS symbol_id
  FROM methods_defined_in_connector mcc
  JOIN code.symbols m ON m.symbol_id = mcc.class_symbol_id || '::' || m.method_name
  WHERE m.qualname LIKE (SELECT symbol_id FROM sql_db_methods) || '::%' OR m.qualname = (SELECT symbol_id FROM sql_db_methods)
),
result AS (
  SELECT cc.class_symbol_id, m.method_name
  FROM methods_defined_in_connector cc
  JOIN code.symbols m ON m.symbol_id = cc.class_symbol_id || '::' || cc.method_name
  WHERE m.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM methods_from_sql_db)
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, method_name FROM result;

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: The query defines CTEs to first locate connector classes that subclass SQLDatabase in the non-test base file, then finds all public, non-underscore methods defined in those classes. It identifies SQLDatabase's own method symbols and excludes any method whose full symbol_id matches one of SQLDatabase's methods, ensuring only truly redefined or new methods are returned.
